name: Uz
overview: Uz is a male figure in Scripture identified as the son of Aram. The Bible does not specify his tribe or provide additional notes about his life. His mention is brief, focusing primarily on his genealogical position within the descendants of Noah.
namesAndTitles: The name Uz appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:23. No specific meaning or divine origin is attributed to the name in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Uz is explicitly recorded as the son of Aram, establishing his place within the family lineage. Beyond this paternal relationship, Scripture does not provide further familial details about Uz.
scriptureSignificance: Uz's significance lies chiefly in his genealogical mention as a descendant of Aram, which situates him within the broader narrative of the nations descended from Noah. This connection helps trace the origins of various peoples mentioned throughout the Old Testament. Though little else is recorded about Uz, his inclusion in the biblical genealogy underscores the importance of lineage in God's providential plan.
